title: Swimming
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Creative Arts and Sports; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts and Sports teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Diving only in deep water with a lifeguard. Questions ask for body position and safety.

skills.key_step: The child describes water entry (sitting, pencil dive feet first, crouch dive from the edge into deep water) and backstroke (on the back, alternate arms, flutter kick, head back).

floor.question: Which kick is used in breaststroke?

steps: Enter safely: pencil dive feet first.
Lie on the back, head back.

board.do: In backstroke, do arms move together?

misconceptions.ask: In a pencil dive, how does the body enter the water?
misconceptions.repair: Show a pencil: straight and pointed down, feet first.

misconceptions.ask: In backstroke the swimmer lies on...
misconceptions.repair: Float on the back first, then add the arms.
Name what could go wrong alone: cramp, a knock on the head.

misconceptions.ask: In backstroke, where should the head be?
misconceptions.repair: Float with ears in the water and look at the roof.
